lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi Grandma, it's me.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Tommy? Is that you?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yeah, it's Tommy. I have a cold, that's why my voice sounds weird.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Can you take me off speaker? I don't want anyone else to hear this.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Grandma, I'm in trouble. I got in a car accident and they took me to jail.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Oh my goodness, are you okay? What do you need, honey?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I need two thousand dollars for bail right now or they will keep me overnight.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please don't tell Mom and Dad, they'll be so mad at me.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Okay, okay, I won't tell them. How do I send it?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: My lawyer says you can pay with gift cards from Target. Can you go get them today?

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: All right, I'll go to Target right now and get the cards.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi Grandma, it's Tommy.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Tommy! How are you, sweetheart?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Not great. My car broke down and I need eight hundred dollars for the repair today, the shop closes at five.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please don't tell Mom, she already thinks I'm bad with money.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Oh honey, of course. I'll send it to you on Zelle right now.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, this is Maria calling from Desert Financial Credit Union.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: This is a courtesy reminder that your auto loan payment is due on the fifteenth.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Oh, thank you, I think I already paid it.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: You can check online, in a branch, or by calling the number on the back of your card.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: If you've already paid, please disregard this message. Have a great day.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi Grandma, it's Jake!

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Jake! So good to hear from you.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I just wanted to call and say I got the job at the hospital.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: That's wonderful, I'm so proud of you.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Are we still doing dinner on Sunday? I can pick you up at five.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Okay, love you, talk soon.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, this is David from Microsoft Windows technical department.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We are seeing a virus on your computer that is sending your bank details to hackers.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Oh no, what should I do?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: You must act right now or your bank account will be frozen today.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please go to your computer and install AnyDesk so I can fix it for you.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Okay, I'm at the computer now. I'm typing in AnyDesk.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi, this is Karen from the Chase fraud prevention team, calling for Rose.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We noticed a charge of four hundred eighty dollars at a Best Buy in Denver this morning. Did you make that purchase?

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: No, I haven't been to Denver. Oh dear.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Okay, thank you. I've blocked that card so nothing else goes through, and a new card will arrive in the mail in five to seven days.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We will never ask for your PIN, your full card number or a code. If you'd like to double check this call, hang up and call the number on the back of your card.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Thank you, I'll call that number just to be safe.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That's a great idea. Have a good afternoon.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Grandma, it's Emily. Grandpa fell in the garden and they took him to Banner hospital.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Oh my goodness, is he okay?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: The doctors think it's just his wrist, but they want to keep him overnight.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Dad is driving over to pick you up in twenty minutes so you can see him.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Okay, I'll get my coat and my purse and wait by the door.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Bring his reading glasses and his phone charger. Love you, see you soon.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi, this is Marcus with Cox Communications, returning your call from this morning about your internet going out.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Oh yes, thank you for calling back.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I see there was an outage in your neighborhood. It was fixed about an hour ago.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Could you unplug the white box by your TV, wait thirty seconds, and plug it back in?

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Okay, I did it. The lights are blinking now.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Perfect, you should be back online. There's no charge for this. Anything else I can help with?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good morning, this is Dr. Patel's office calling to confirm Rose's appointment.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: For privacy, can you please confirm your date of birth?

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: It's March third, nineteen forty-six.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Thank you. You're scheduled for Thursday at ten thirty with Dr. Patel.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please bring your insurance card and a list of your medications. If you need to reschedule, just call the office.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Thursday at ten thirty, got it. Thank you.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi Rose, it's Linda from Saint Mary's. How are you doing?

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Linda! I'm doing well, thank you.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We're collecting for the food bank drive this month. If you'd like to give, you can drop a check in the box at Sunday service.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No pressure at all, every bit helps. We're also looking for volunteers to sort cans on Saturday.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: I'll bring a check on Sunday, and maybe I can help on Saturday too.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Wonderful. See you Sunday!
